evidence.title: GitHub - dmmulroy/anti-slop: Opinionated Oxlint rules for rejecting low-evidence TypeScript and JavaScript patterns · GitHub

name: anti-slop
summary: Agent skill that installs opinionated Oxlint rules rejecting low-evidence TypeScript and JavaScript patterns.
description: The dmmulroy/anti-slop repo ships one agent skill, install-anti-slop, which sets up opinionated Oxlint rules for TypeScript and JavaScript code: generic rules plus optional Effect rules, flagging patterns such as no-array-filter-map and no-reduce-accumulator-copy. Install with npx skills add dmmulroy/anti-slop; the repo is MIT licensed with 5.4K GitHub stars and the skill shows 12.3K installs on skills.sh.
